title: Bridge Pattern
overview: Decouple an abstraction from its implementation so the two can vary independently.
useCases: Two dimensions of a class hierarchy should vary independently
You want to avoid a combinatorial explosion of subclasses
You want to separate abstraction (e.g. Shape) from implementation (e.g. Colour)
exampleUses: A notification system where message types (Alert, Report) are separated from delivery channels (Email, SMS, Push) so each combination works without a dedicated subclass
A drawing tool that separates shape types (Circle, Rectangle) from rendering backends (SVG, Canvas, PDF) to support any combination
A remote control abstraction that works with any device (TV, DVD, Radio) independently of the control's button layout
